cards.notes: Falak Tayyeb points: 10% on grocery, dine-in and fuel, 2% other retail, caps per statement period. Redemption described as cashback in AED; we assume 1 point = AED 1 of the stated percentage, so confirm against the programme terms. Mawarid does not reassess mis-coded merchants. About 40 MCCs excluded (ATM, telecom, utilities, insurance, parking, tax, government, charity, rent, quasi-cash). Min credit limit AED 30,000. Verified against Mawarid KFS and schedule of tariffs (Nov 2026): FX conversion fee 3.00%, late fee AED 175 (commitment to donate), cash advance 3.10%/month, profit 3.10%/month illustrative, min income AED 5,000 per KFS (general; premium cards need a higher credit limit). Network Mastercard per the Mastercard Travel Pass/offer pages; the KFS does not name it. No welcome offer found on the card page; Mastercard offer PDFs not read (fetch budget ran out). Falak Tayyeb earn rates and caps from the programme page; KFS gives no points value, so 1 point = AED 1 of stated percentage remains an assumption.
